text:
alex: Sharing the follow-up list from the auth token postmortem. Root causes: expiring external signing key + missing permission canary + audit schema lacking user_id for two token routes. Please ack ownerships.

mina: I'll pick up the canary/tests. Plan: add 4 tiny pytest checks + a Datadog metric. Target: 2026-03-28. Creating tracker card.

carla: I'll own audit schema and the event emission (user_id + request_id). Est 2 sprints, can compress to 1 if we freeze minor UI PRs. Draft PR will be redwood/auth#1203.

ops: On-prem rotation window requested: 2026-04-08 01:00-03:00 UTC. Ops will send customer notices 2026-04-01.

alex: I'll do key-rotation automation and the staged-swap flow. Rotation policy change: monthly with old key valid 48h. Will add CI dry-run and runbook commands.

pm-bot: Reminder: please acknowledge assigned actions in 24h. Tracker link: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2071. Auto-reminder scheduled in 48h.

mina: Proposed canary query (DT): logs("service:auth AND source:token AND !user_id").rollup("count").last("10m") > 5

carla: noted, will add migration plan for consumers of audit events. Also documenting rollback: staged swap with immediate revert using `scripts/rotate-keys --rollback`.

alex: Checklist added to tracker: key rotation job + dry-run, IAM role review, audit events patch, canary + playbook, customer notice. Next sync Tue 09:00. Leaving thread open for status updates. :thumbsup:
